title: Exact Candidate Attempt Provenance Contract
problem: Multiple kernel_candidate_state_t objects may currently share lineage, origin revision and interval. That tuple therefore cannot prove that a downstream accepted-only result belongs to the exact candidate object committed by F-KT.

contract.execution_identity: A kernel executor may be explicitly bound to one positive runtime execution-provenance id allocated by the runtime/worker layer. The id is runtime metadata, not persistent physical state.
contract.candidate_sequence: Each successfully materialized candidate from that executor receives a strictly increasing positive int64 sequence within the bound execution identity.
contract.exact_candidate_identity: The pair execution_provenance_id + candidate_sequence is opaque, immutable candidate provenance in addition to existing lineage/revision/interval provenance.
contract.receipt_transport: Accepted commit receipt captures the exact candidate identity before F-KT clears the committed candidate and publishes it only after successful commit.
contract.surface_transport: Candidate-bound surface result carries the same exact identity and accepted publication requires exact match with the receipt.
contract.fail_closed: Surface accepted publication is unavailable when exact attempt provenance is absent or mismatched. Existing generic F-KT commit semantics remain available without this optional provenance layer.

runtime_obligation: Runtime/coupler must allocate execution_provenance_id values uniquely among simultaneously live executor provenance domains that may act on the same logical transaction lineage. No hidden global id generator is introduced in the kernel.
bounded_scope: accepted commit receipt exact provenance transport
surface candidate-bound result exact provenance transport
owner tests for duplicate same-tuple candidates

invariant_mapping.4: attempt provenance is not persistent physical column state
invariant_mapping.5: execution identity and sequence belong to worker/job executor scratch
invariant_mapping.7: receipt preserves exact identity of the candidate actually committed
invariant_mapping.8: repeated trials from one committed origin receive distinct attempt identities without changing the committed origin
invariant_mapping.16: one lightweight pair of int64 values per live candidate, not heavy per-column solver state
invariant_mapping.26: attempt identity is available for diagnostics/provenance
invariant_mapping.29: identity has no calendar, file or MODFLOW assumption
invariant_mapping.30: requires separate owner and independent qualification before admission

nonclaims: execution_provenance_id is not generated globally by F-KT
uniqueness across simultaneously live executors depends on the explicit runtime allocation contract
this workunit does not itself canonically admit the contract
